name: wordpress-popup

hustle_settings.note: The global settings blob: permissions, privacy, recaptcha display, dashboard analytics. Credentials live in the per-provider options held env below, not here.

hustle_database_version.note: Hustle_Db::DB_VERSION_KEY. maybe_create_tables() compares it and runs dbDelta, so it is installation bookkeeping, never portable intent.

hustle_unsubscribe_page.note: hustle-module-front.php:1158-1160 stores get_permalink() output, an absolute URL. Nothing in this slice rebinds a scalar option URL to a target home, so carrying it would point a target's unsubscribe mail at the source site.

module_id.note: A hustle_module id. widget_setting_refs admits only term and post, so a custom-table entity cannot be declared as a widget reference here; the value is carried verbatim and does not resolve on a target. Recorded as an engine-gap candidate rather than mis-declared as a post reference.

notes: Experimental authoring capsule measured against the exact official Hustle 7.8.14.2 artifact in this capsule's evidence lock. Every rule was read out of that artifact's source; none has a completed live conformance run behind it. No certification, deployment, apply, deletion, lifecycle or production-readiness claim.

Hustle registers NO post type and NO taxonomy. Its authored content lives entirely in two custom tables created by Hustle_Db::get_tables() (inc/class-hustle-db.php:225-267): hustle_modules holds one row per popup/slide-in/embed/social module, and hustle_modules_meta holds that module's content, design, display, settings, visibility and email configuration as longtext meta rows keyed by the Hustle_Model KEY_* constants (inc/hustle-model.php:18-38).

hustle_entries, hustle_entries_meta and hustle_tracking are visitor submissions, submission metadata and view/conversion counters. All three are runtime and deliberately excluded: entries_meta in particular holds submitted form values, which are visitor data and never authored configuration.

The shortcode id has two forms and only one of them is portable. hustle-model.php:891-917 first looks the attribute up as a shortcode_id meta string, then falls back to treating it as the numeric module_id ('Since 4.2.1, the modules are retrieved by their ID, not by a shortcode ID'). The numeric form is an auto-increment that must be rebound, which is why the three shortcodes declare kind hustle_module; whether the legacy string form survives that declaration is exactly what live evidence must decide, and the disposition records it as unproven.

integrations_settings and every hustle_provider_*_settings option hold third-party API credentials and list bindings, so they stay target-local. hustle_unsubscribe_page stores an absolute permalink rather than an id and is withheld on the same grounds as any unrebindable URL.

Not claimed: the newsletter_customfields option (an unprefixed name this plugin writes but does not own exclusively, so declaring it would risk one-owner-per-name conflict with another adapter), the legacy inc_opt_widget, Pro/WPMU DEV Dashboard surfaces, and every provider integration's own remote state.
